observations: Photo 0: Industrial sewing machine on a white table/stand, wide shot of a room. Pink measuring tape draped over the machine head, scissors and white thread spool on table. Below the table: bags of clothing/fabric, a boxed clutch motor labeled 'EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR', assorted items, and a red flat case on the floor. Patterned floor tiles, bare plaster wall, on/off switch box mounted on the table leg.

Photo 1: Closer view of the same sewing machine head, showing a red oval badge reading 'Emel' and text on the machine body. Two thread spool holders mounted on a post at the back. Pink tape measure, scissors, and small metal parts tray on the table. Same boxed 'EMEL CLUTCH MOTOR' with 'EM350A-H' and CE mark visible under the table. Red flat case on the floor, same tiled floor and wall as photo 0. Watermark text 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'LEKZEE BADMUS' overlaid.
not_shown: Working condition / whether motor runs smoothly
Age and prior usage hours of the machine
Completeness of accessories (bobbins, needles, extra feet)
Condition of wiring and foot pedal mechanism
Whether the boxed clutch motor is new/unused or already installed elsewhere
